headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.81
summary: Fixed mod launches hanging: the App-Level Logging hook now installs only after all mods finish loading.

items.text: Fixed launches hanging at 1/N during native mod loading: the log hook is no longer initialized before or during the mod loading window.
App-Level Logging is now active in-game only; before a launch the overlay falls back to regular logcat.
